R/ is PROV DEOR [TR P XVI COS III]

A silver Roman coin; a denarius of Marcus Aurelius (AD 161 - 180), dating from AD 161 - 162, (Reece Period 8). The reverse legend is PROV DEOR [TR P XVI COS III] and it depicts Providentia standing left holding a globe and cornucopia. Mint of Rome. Compare RIC III, page 217, number 51 and LANCUM-45054B.
